system.name: SRNIC
system.one_liner: a scalable hardware architecture for RDMA NICs that separates fast and slow paths for outbound and inbound traffic

components.name: Application
components.role: generates data to send over RDMA

components.name: Buffer
components.role: holds data awaiting retransmission on the outbound path

components.name: Software Retransmission
components.role: handles retransmission for the inbound slow path in software

components.name: QP
components.role: queue-pair state used by the driver

components.name: Tx
components.role: transmit completion/queue handling on the inbound fast path

components.name: CtrlQ
components.role: control queue for the inbound slow path

components.name: Data Mover
components.role: moves data between host memory and the RNIC over PCIe

components.name: Congestion Control
components.role: controls the sending rate to avoid congestion

components.name: Hardware Retransmission
components.role: handles retransmission for the inbound fast path directly in hardware

components.name: MTT
components.role: memory translation table for address translation

content.key_idea: SRNIC keeps the common inbound case in a fast hardware path with hardware retransmission, while an uncommon inbound slow path escalates to software retransmission in user space, all connected to the host over PCIe.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom, following the three colored arrows (Outbound, Inbound Fast, Inbound Slow) from the CPU's User space and Driver, across PCIe, into the RNIC.

encoding.color_means: blue marks the outbound data path; solid red marks the inbound fast path; dashed red marks the inbound slow path that goes through software retransmission

encoding.emphasis: three parallel colored arrows running top-to-bottom through the whole figure make the three data paths (outbound, inbound fast, inbound slow) the organizing idea, with the PCIe boundary separating CPU software from RNIC hardware

evidence: we design a scalable RDMA NIC architecture SRNIC, as shown in Figure 4

summary: Figure 4 gives the overall architecture of SRNIC, a scalable RDMA NIC design, split across a CPU host (top) and the RNIC hardware (bottom) connected via PCIe. On the CPU, user-space Application, Buffer, and Software Retransmission components sit above a Driver layer with send/receive/retry queues (SQ, RQ, RetryQ, QP) and completion/control queues (Tx, Rx, CtrlQ). On the RNIC, a Transport layer contains a Data Mover, QP Scheduler, Congestion Control, Hardware Retransmission, and per-connection state (QPC, MTT) above a Basic NIC with a 100GE MAC. Three colored arrows running through the whole stack label the Outbound Path, the Inbound Fast Path (handled by Hardware Retransmission, staying in hardware), and the Inbound Slow Path (dashed, escalating to Software Retransmission in user space), organizing the architecture around these three traffic paths rather than around individual components.
summary_zh: 图4展示SRNIC架构：CPU主机（应用/缓冲区/软件重传，驱动含SQ/RQ/RetryQ）经PCIe连RNIC硬件（Data Mover、QP调度、拥塞控制、硬件重传、QPC/MTT）。三色箭头标出三条数据路径。
